Scorer World sends usage counters to stats.clemir.com: app openings and closes, careers created and loaded, training, matches, goals and save/load failures. No names, career files or device IDs are included. Pending counters expire after 7 days; server daily totals after 90 days. Cloudflare processes connection data, including IP addresses. Public record sharing is separate and optional. OK continues with automatic usage reporting; NOT OK closes the game.
